senses.en: fight sb. by holding them and pulling or pushing them
examples: The two men [[wrestled]] with each other, and it was hard to tell who would win.

senses.zh: （讨论、战争等无法预知的）结果、后果
senses.en: the final result of a discussion, war, etc. — used esp. when no one knows what it will be until it actually happens
examples: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the [[outcome]].

senses.en: (also 'tense up') make your muscles tight and stiff, or become tight and stiff
examples: Every time the phone rang, she [[tensed]] up, being afraid to hear the bad news.

senses.zh: 令人紧张的；令人不安的；令人着急的
senses.en: making you feel nervous and not relaxed, usu. because you are worried about what is going to happen
examples: There was a [[tense]] silence as everyone waited for his reaction.

senses.en: try very hard to do sth. using all your strength or ability
examples: She was [[straining]] to keep her head above the water.

senses.en: injure a muscle or part of your body by using it too much or making it work too hard
examples: I've [[strained]] a muscle in my leg and I have to go to hospital.
He grasped her [[wrist]] with his free hand.

senses.en: smile widely
examples: He walked out of the pool, [[grinning]] widely.

senses.zh: 青少年时期（13 到 19 岁之间的阶段）
senses.en: (~s) the period of your life when you are between 13 and 19 years old
examples: She was in her [[teens]] when she met her boyfriend who became her husband.

senses.en: (AmE, infml.) a teenager
examples: In real life, every [[teen]] can, and should, make their own decision.

senses.en: physically strong and good at sport
examples: I am not a brave man, nor am I [[athletic]].

senses.en: the ability to play sports or do physical activities well
examples: Except for the second game he seemed to be in control and showed some great [[athleticism]].

senses.en: breathe quickly in a way that can be heard because you are having difficulty breathing
examples: Brendan climbed slowly, [[gasping]] for breath.

senses.zh: （尤因惊讶或疼痛而）大声吸气，倒抽气
senses.en: breathe in suddenly in a way that can be heard, esp. because you are surprised or in pain
examples: The visitors [[gasped]] at the wonderful view.

senses.en: remember a particular fact, event, or situation from the past
examples: Henry [[recalled]] that he first met Pollard during a business trip to Washington.

senses.en: cut an article or picture from a newspaper, magazine, etc.
examples: He showed me a cartoon [[clipped]] from a newspaper.

senses.en: an article or picture that has been cut out of a newspaper or magazine
examples: He searched through piles of letters and [[clippings]] for his mother's letter.

senses.en: draw a line under a word, sentence, etc. to show that it is important
examples: Please [[underline]] all the noun clauses in the reading passage.

senses.en: a strong hard hat that soldiers, motorcycle riders, the police, etc. wear to protect their heads
examples: Protective [[helmets]] must be worn on the construction site.

senses.en: fight or struggle with sb., holding them tightly
examples: Two men didn't stop [[grappling]] with a guard at the door until the police came.

senses.en: sth. that you do regularly and in the same way each time
examples: He lights his cigar after getting up every morning and this [[ritual]] has not changed for many years.

senses.zh: （为纪念重要宗教或社会事件举行的）仪式，典礼
senses.en: a ceremony that is always performed in the same way, in order to mark an important religious or social occasion
examples: The lady of the house still performs the [[ritual]] of lighting candles at dinner.

senses.en: having or displaying a strong desire to be more successful than others
examples: I could never play team sports 一 I lack the [[competitive]] spirit.

senses.en: turn a part of your body around or change your position by turning
examples: He [[twisted]] his head slightly and looked up at her.

senses.en: if you wrap your arms, legs, or fingers around sth., you use them to hold it
examples: He [[wrapped]] his arms around her, unwilling to leave.

senses.en: (also 'wrap up') put paper or cloth over sth. to cover it
examples: The present was beautifully [[wrapped]] in gold paper.

senses.en: the way you hold sth. tightly, or your ability to do this
examples: Hold the microphone in a firm [[grip]] and keep it still.
He rested one [[elbow]] on the wall as he spoke.

senses.en: (also 'indent') a cut into the surface or edge of sth.
examples: The kid made an [[indentation]] in the center of each cookie.

senses.en: if clothes are itchy, they make your skin feel slightly unpleasant, so that you want to rub your skin with your nails
examples: The shirt is [[itchy]] and uncomfortable.

senses.en: if part of your body is itchy, it feels slightly unpleasant and you want to rub it with your nails
examples: My eyes sometimes get red and [[itchy]] in the summer.

senses.en: failure to win or succeed
examples: She was a woman who hated to admit [[defeat]].

senses.en: stop resisting sb. / sth.; agree to do sth. that you do not want to do
examples: He reluctantly [[yielded]] to their demands.

senses.zh: 产生，得出（结果、答案或消息）
senses.en: produce a result, answer, or piece of information
examples: Our research has only recently begun to [[yield]] important results.

senses.zh: 稳定的；牢固的；不摇晃的
senses.en: firmly held in a particular position and not moving or shaking
examples: Keep the camera [[steady]] while you take a picture.

senses.en: developing gradually or without stopping, and not likely to change
examples: The study also notes a [[steady]] drop in the number of college students taking science courses.

senses.en: in a way that involves shaking or moving in a way you cannot control
examples: I walked [[unsteadily]] to another room and looked outside.

senses.zh: 想不到的；意外的；突然的
senses.en: used to describe sth. that is surprising because you were not expecting it
examples: The experiment with new methods produced some [[unexpected]] results.

senses.en: the act of taking sb.'s right hand and shaking it, which people do when they meet or leave each other or when they have reached an agreement
examples: He greeted me with a firm [[handshake]].

senses.en: take air, liquid, etc. into your mouth by making your lips form a small hole and using the muscles of your mouth to pull it in
examples: He [[sucked]] hard for air to keep breathing.

senses.en: (~ oneself / sb. for) mentally or physically prepare yourself or sb. else for sth. unpleasant that is going to happen
examples: Nancy [[braced]] herself for the inevitable arguments during the meeting.

senses.en: the act of holding sb. close to you, esp. as a sign of love
examples: They held each other in a tender [[embrace]].

senses.en: put your arms around sb. and hold them in a friendly or loving way
examples: The couple were sort of crying for joy and [[embracing]] each other.

senses.en: the state of feeling sad
examples: It was with great [[sadness]] that we learned of his death.

senses.en: a low table with a mirror where one sits while applying makeup
examples: Mary took the watch out of her [[dresser]] and put it on.

senses.en: a piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes, sometimes with a mirror on top
examples: He put the pants in the [[dresser]] and went to bed.

senses.en: (slung, slung) hang sth. loosely
examples: She likes to wear a belt [[slung]] around her waist.

senses.en: (slung, slung) throw or put sth. somewhere with a careless movement and some force
examples: He stood up and [[slung]] his gun over his shoulder.

senses.en: bigger than usual or too big
examples: I'm sorry. Your parcel is a bit [[oversized]].

senses.en: (only before noun) used when you want to emphasize that you mean all of a group, period of time, amount, etc.
examples: He was so tired that he slept through the [[entire]] movie.

senses.en: (AmE) a structure built onto the front or back entrance of a house, with a floor and a roof but no walls

senses.zh: （房子或教堂前门外有顶的）入口，门廊
senses.en: (BrE) an entrance covered by a roof outside the front door of a house or church
a small box made of cardboard or plastic that contains food or a drink
examples: She was so thirsty that she drank a [[carton]] of orange juice.

senses.en: (rewound, rewound) make a cassette tape or video go backward in order to see or hear it again
examples: He [[rewound]] the tape and replayed a few pieces.

senses.en: drink sth. slowly, taking very small mouthfuls
examples: She was sitting at the table [[sipping]] her coffee.

senses.en: (pl. patios) a flat hard area near a house, where people sit outside
the railway system

senses.zh: （道义或法律上的）义务，职责，责任
senses.en: a moral or legal duty to do sth.
examples: Employers have an [[obligation]] to treat all employees equally.

senses.zh: 使安心；使放心；使消除疑虑
senses.en: make sb. feel calmer and less worried or frightened about a problem or situation
examples: He tried to [[reassure]] me, but I still felt anxious.

senses.en: written by hand, not printed
examples: Would you like the essay typed or [[handwritten]]?

senses.en: without feeling ashamed of your bad behavior although other people think you should be ashamed
examples: He [[shamelessly]] abandoned the project when he realized he would not gain any benefits from it.

senses.en: (not before noun) unable to control your behavior, speech, etc. because you have drunk too much alcohol
examples: David got [[drunk]] and I had to take him home and put him to bed.

senses.en: a storm with thunder and lightning
examples: Eventually, the [[thunderstorm]] stopped and we saw a beautiful rainbow in the sky.

senses.zh: （尤指表示喜爱而）抱，拥抱，搂抱
senses.en: hold sb. / sth. very close to you with your arms around them, esp. to show that you love them
examples: Dawn and her boyfriend were [[cuddling]] on the sofa.

senses.en: (be ~ on / upon) be directly affected or decided by sth. else
examples: Your pay is [[dependent]] on how much you produce.

senses.en: needing sb. / sth. in order to survive or be successful
examples: You can't be [[dependent]] on your parents all your life.

senses.en: let sb. get into your car, boat, etc. and take them somewhere
examples: I'll [[pick]] you [[up]] at the station and take you to the dinner party afterward.

senses.en: work effectively toward countering or defeating sb. / sth.
examples: I heard that pepper spray [[works]] well [[against]] bears.

senses.en: if an aircraft or spacecraft lifts off, it leaves the ground and rises into the air
examples: The aeroplane [[lifted off]] at noon for New York with more than 100 passengers.

senses.en: not go to bed at the time you would normally go to bed
examples: With so much homework to do, I will have to [[stay up]] late tonight.

senses.en: accept sth. even though it is not the best, or not what you really want
examples: They want $2,500 for it, but they might [[settle for]] $2,000.

senses.en: near enough to walk to easily
examples: She used to live [[within walking distance]] of her children.

senses.en: if sth. is on your mind, you keep thinking or worrying about it
examples: He looked as though he had something [[on his mind]].

english: at the top of one's lungs

senses.en: as loudly as possible
examples: He came running up to me screaming [[at the top of his lungs]], "I love you!"

senses.en: lie or sit very close to sb. / sth.
examples: We [[cuddled up]] together to keep out the cold.
